execution.system_prompt: Return one JSON object and do not use tools.

source.expected: compare now - ts vs max_age; exactly-at-age is fresh; strictly older is stale; payload presence is not freshness

source.prompt: A data ingestion service accepted stale records because it only checked that the payload was non-empty — it never compared the record timestamp against the current reference time. Old cached data kept flowing in while dashboards stayed green. Return the one-line fix rule in answer: it must say to compare now - ts against max_age, must state the boundary caliber explicitly (a record exactly at max_age is still fresh; strictly older than max_age is stale and must be rejected), and must say payload presence is not freshness. Put a reusable instruction for any ingestion/validation boundary in reuse_advice.

transfer.prompt: A pipeline receives records each carrying epoch timestamp ts. Given current reference epoch now and max freshness age max_age in seconds, return ONE plain boolean expression in terms of now, ts, max_age that is True exactly when the record is fresh enough to accept. Choose the staleness convention yourself; no lambda, no function definition.
